title: Barnaby at eight, iv
logline: Thursday. Gully's. The dog under the stool, where he has been every day for four years. Gully says 'eight.' Wood says 'eight.' That's the strip. The counter, the coffee, the dog, the number.

panels.composition: Gully's. WOOD on the end stool. GULLY. BARNABY under the stool.
